Connor / Vanessa — looping in a short legal response and the plan for counters. I reviewed Clearwater_Renewal_TrackChanges.docx and our key points are below. Attached: RW_Legal_Responses_track.docx (redline against their draft).

Legal highlights / positions: 
1) Term & price protection: we can accept 24 months with a 12-month price protection clause. We will add explicit language about repricing post-protection period.
2) Indemnity / liability cap: we propose keeping mutual indemnities but cannot accept an unlimited liability carveout. Counter proposes a cap equal to 12 months of fees for direct damages, with carveouts for gross negligence/fraud.
3) Data processing & residency: add DPA with US-only data processing for tenant data; SOC 2 Type II report will be provided under NDA or through our security portal.
4) SLA: we will offer a 99.9% uptime SLA for Dedicated with credits capped as % of monthly fees; we will not agree to service credits that exceed a pre-agreed cap.
5) Audit window / notice: limit formal audits to once per 12 months and require reasonable coordination.

Open items that need customer confirmation: 
- Exact Exhibit A numbers for baseline vs peak (ops to confirm).
- Whether Clearwater requires a separate sideletter for onboarding credits or true-up mechanics.
- Confirmation on who signs on behalf of Clearwater (Dana or CFO).

Timing: we will produce the counter-redline (RW_Legal_Responses_track.docx) by 9/13 and are prepared to move to DocuSign once the pricing sheet is attached. If the customer insists on different liability language, escalate to VP Legal (I’ll loop them if needed).

-Markus Klein
